name: Thick Pelt no longer arms from the Bloodmage's own swings (#2325)
contract: Thick Pelt 704626 reads 'Physical damage taken now reduces the Physical damage taken from the next attack within $556233d by ${($556233m1+$AP*0.2)}'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Thick Pelt 556233 (MOD_DAMAGE_TAKEN, MiscValue 1 = physical, BasePoints -16 -> -15, ProcCharges 1, TargetA 1). Unlike the rest of this batch, Spell.dbc does give 704626 a proc flag - and it is the wrong one: ProcFlags 0x4 is PROC_FLAG_DONE_MELEE_AUTO_ATTACK, so the generated entry armed the buff on the Bloodmage's own outgoing swings. 556233 itself carries ProcFlags 0x2a8, the TAKEN melee/ranged set that matches the tooltip. This scenario proves the negative half only: after the fix the Bloodmage's own auto attacks must no longer arm 556233. NOT PROVABLE HERE - the positive half. CoAGameplayTest.cpp forces every fixture creature to REACT_PASSIVE at creation and again after CombatStop, and CreatureAI::UpdateVictim takes the passive branch for a creature in combat and calls me->AttackStop() (src/server/game/AI/CreatureAI.cpp:372-379); CreatureAI::AttackedBy is an empty stub (src/server/game/AI/CreatureAI.h:180, the real body is commented out at CreatureAI.cpp:317). A fixture creature therefore never swings back, whatever its faction, so no TAKEN-proc contract can be observed in this harness. A Ghost e2e test would have to: put a class-20 character with Thick Pelt 704626 in melee range of an ordinary world mob (not a harness fixture), let the mob land at least one physical auto attack on the character, and check that aura 556233 is on the character within its duration. NOTE: even with the proc condition corrected, #2325 is not settled - the tooltip's $AP*0.2 term is delivered by nothing (556233 has BasePoints -16 with EffectRealPointsPerLevel 0, no spell_bonus_data row, and its own text states $AP*0.25), and the amount is not asserted here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Thick Pelt passive is active
Swing at the neutral bag long enough for several auto attacks to land
SETUP: the Bloodmage really did swing, so the next assertion is not vacuous
DISCRIMINATING: the Bloodmage's own swings do not arm Thick Pelt 556233
